commentary.keyPhraseRelied: إنا أنزلناه في ليلة القدر المباركة كثيرة الخيرات، وهي في رمضان

hadith.label: Sahih al-Bukhari 2024
hadith.gradingShown: No grade shown on sunnah.com for this Bukhari entry; listed in Sahih al-Bukhari.
hadith.useInPack: Aisha reports that when the last ten days of Ramadan began, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ would work hard, spend the night in prayer and wake his family. Paraphrased.

items.title: Our Lord, forgive us

commentary.keyPhraseRelied: قال آدم وحواء: ربنا ظلمنا أنفسنا ... (وهذه الكلمات هي التي تلقاها آدم من ربه، فدعا بها فتاب الله عليه)

hadith.label: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 3513
hadith.useInPack: Aisha asks the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ what to say if she knows the Night of Qadr. He teaches a short dua asking Allah, who loves pardon, to pardon her. Graded Sahih (Darussalam) on sunnah.com. Paraphrased.

hadith.label: Sahih al-Bukhari 2014
hadith.gradingShown: No grade shown on sunnah.com for this Bukhari entry; listed in Sahih al-Bukhari.
hadith.useInPack: Abu Hurairah reports the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ saying that whoever stands in prayer on the Night of Qadr out of faith and hoping for Allah’s reward will have past sins forgiven. Paraphrased.
